evidence: Provisional. Native extraction (rc-nom.json, Magic resistance model) of the routed one-SRAM micro block of the SKY130 bring-up: nets with at least 100 um routed length (126 nets): median 0.593 ohm/um including vias (quartiles 0.470, 0.593, 0.881), median 0.162 fF/um (quartiles 0.144, 0.162, 0.183). The detour factor is the IHP policy's value; the micro block's routed/MST quartiles (0.45, 0.95, 1.17) are not usable because its MST is taken over instance origins only. To be re-derived from the routed benchmark.
